---
name: vercel-runtime
description: Use the private VERCEL · X-TiMe MCP tools to inspect, link, dry-run, deploy, bind domains, and read back Vercel production from a local runtime controlled by the user.
---

# VERCEL · X-TiMe runtime

Use this skill when deploying or auditing X-TiMe through Vercel without relying on a marketplace Vercel plugin.

Rules:
- Use `VERCEL_TOKEN` only from the runtime environment. Never echo it, persist it, or place it in plugin files.
- Prefer `vercel_dry_run` before `vercel_deploy` for consequential production deploys.
- Use `vercel_link` with the stable project ID/name when known; do not create similarly named duplicate projects unless explicitly required.
- For X-TiMe production, preserve source provenance and deploy only the intended public build surface.
- A successful build or deploy command is not a domain PASS. After deploy, use `vercel_domain_inspect` and `vercel_http_readback`.
- If DNS is external, report the required Vercel configuration and leave registrar/DNS mutation to its authorized carrier.
- Never claim local/device execution unless the stdio server actually returned a receipt.
